backend.source_model_description: Offline SPARQL graph exploration and hybrid pairwise similarity; relational DB storage; runtime SQL-to-XML generator and Flash client

descriptions.interaction: Choose a seed from autocomplete; navigate a star of10 related resources; use visited-node list and backward/forward history
descriptions.guidance: DBpediaRanker combines RDF structure, resource abstracts/wikilinks and external search/tag co-occurrence; top10 association recommendations
descriptions.visualisation: Flash node-link cloud with relevance-scaled circles, category/instance colors, resource abstract and navigation history
descriptions.backend: Offline SPARQL graph exploration and hybrid pairwise similarity; relational DB storage; runtime SQL-to-XML generator and Flash client
descriptions.evaluation: System/interface description and illustrative IT-domain exploration; refers to separate ranking work
descriptions.scalability: {"strategy": "Offline graph traversal limited to2hops and selected SKOS properties; stored pair scores; generate only top10 neighbors per view", "dataset_context": "DBpedia3.5.1 described as over1billion triples; not a measured full-graph performance experiment", "measured_latency": null, "limitation": "External search/tag services and offline similarity/freshness dependencies"}
